title: Grounding-Source Comparison Exhibit: llms.txt vs knowledge-graph.json vs OKF v0.3

dataset.name: reading-chain questions derived from clouatre.ca knowledge-graph.json readingChains
dataset.source: clouatre.ca experiments/src/idea-bank.ts reading-chain generation (deterministic from public/knowledge-graph.json)

kg-json.payload: /knowledge-graph.json plus the deterministic cluster slice for the target post
kg-json.cluster_slice_rule: target post clusters frontmatter first entry -> public/knowledge-graph/<id>.json

okf-bundle.payload: /okf/ root index plus concept files reachable via the same cluster rule

primary_metric.name: exact sequence match
primary_metric.definition: resolveChainSequence exact match of predicted slug sequence against the readingChains ground truth

secondary_metric.name: partial credit (per-step prefix credit)
secondary_metric.definition: fraction of leading steps in the predicted sequence that match the expected ordered slug prefix, computed post-hoc by analysis.py from raw logs
secondary_metric.computed: post-hoc from results/raw/ full raw responses

pilot_gate.rule: best arm must achieve >= 3/20 exact matches on the pilot subset; otherwise STOP and re-register

statistics.primary: two-proportion score test on pairwise exact-match deltas
statistics.reporting: raw p-values only, no multiplicity adjustment

raw_response_logging.requirement: full raw response per run persisted to results/raw/ for all arms
raw_response_logging.rationale: upstream bench D1 samples table caps captured bodies at body_512b; partial credit requires untruncated responses
